title: plugin.json v0: contributes
description: What a plugin adds to the desk's policies as data: commands, keys, display rules, file openers, themes, settings, profiles and palette providers. The runtime layers every enabled plugin's contributions: the built-in desk.* policy plugins first, then the others, then init.yaml, then the active profile (ADR 0017).

PluginContributes.description: A plugin's contributions. Every list is optional; the runtime ignores commands, settings and themes outside the plugin's own id.

commands.description: Commands the plugin answers (ctx.commands.on in the SDK). Their ids start with the plugin id.

keys.description: Key bindings, like a keymap. A later layer's binding of the same key wins.

display.description: Where new surfaces go, like display-buffer-alist. Later layers are asked first; the first rule that matches decides.

files.description: Which plugin opens which files, like auto-mode-alist. Later layers are asked first.

themes.description: Themes: one token set for a scheme and a contrast.

settings.description: Settings the plugin reads, by key, with their defaults. Keys start with the plugin id.

profiles.description: Profiles: a plugin set plus settings, like an init file.

paletteProviders.description: Commands the palette asks as the person types, each listing its answers in a group of its own after the commands. Their commands start with the plugin id; later layers' groups come after earlier ones.

CommandId.description: A command id: lowercase and dotted, with at least two segments, for example eris.say or desk.palette.open. Unique across callers (bridge cmd.*); a plugin's contributed commands start with its own id.

CommandContribution.description: A command the palette lists and keys can run.

runs.description: Makes the command an alias the desk answers while the plugin is on: it runs this command with these args, the caller's object args merged over them key by key. Data-only plugins (view, policy) offer commands this way.

CommandArgs.description: A command's args: an object, as cmd.invoke passes them.

CommandCall.description: A command and the args it is run with.

PaletteProvider.description: A command the palette runs with a PaletteQuery whenever the typed query changes (two characters or more), and whose PaletteResults it lists under title.

title.description: The group's name in the palette: Items.

PaletteQuery.description: What the palette asks a provider: the query as typed, trimmed, and how many results it shows.

PaletteResults.description: What a provider answers: its results, best first. The palette shows up to the limit it asked for.

PaletteResult.description: One result: what it shows, and the commands that act on it, in order. Enter runs the first, Mod+Enter the second.

id.description: Unique among the provider's results: an item's connector/instance/id.

detail.description: A second, quieter line: Task · desk.fixtures.

kind.description: A short lowercase word for what it is: an item kind for items (task, event), or the provider's own (file, plugin).

PaletteAction.description: A command the palette runs on a result, with its args.

title.description: Shown under the results: Open in Desk.

KeyCombo.description: Modifiers and one key joined with +, for example Mod+K, Mod+Shift+], Escape. Mod is Meta on macOS and Control elsewhere.

KeyCommand.description: The command a key runs, or the empty string to take the key away from an earlier layer.

KeyBinding.description: One key bound to one command.

mac.description: The key on macOS, when it differs from key.

args.description: Passed to the command. Any JSON value.

DisplayRule.description: A condition and where a matching surface goes.

reuse.description: Show a surface that is already open instead of opening it again. Default true.

focus.description: Move the keyboard focus to the surface when it opens. Default false.

DisplayMatch.description: Which surfaces a rule is for. Every field given must match; an empty match matches every surface.

plugin.description: A plugin id, with * for any run of characters (endue.*).

surface.description: A surface id from the plugin's manifest.

DisplaySize.description: How big the surface is: grid cells on the grid, pixels on an edge.

pixels.description: The edge's width (left, right) or height (bottom).

FileOpener.description: Files matching pattern open in plugin.

pattern.description: A glob on the file name (*.md), or on the whole path when it has a slash.

ThemeId.description: A theme id: the owner's plugin id and a name, for example desk.theme.dark.

ThemeContribution.description: One token set. The runtime picks the theme for the scheme and contrast in force.

tokens.description: Token name (camelCase, as in @endue-ai/ui) to CSS colour.

SettingName.description: A setting's full name, as in init.yaml: the owner's id and its key, dotted (desk.notify.dnd).

SettingKind.description: The JSON type a setting's value has.

SettingContribution.description: A setting and its default. init.yaml and profiles set other values.

default.description: The value until a later layer sets one. Any JSON value.

choices.description: The values a string setting may take.

ProfileId.description: A profile name, as init.yaml names the one to start in.

ProfilePlugins.description: Which plugins a profile turns on and off. Plugins it names neither way keep their state.

ProfileContribution.description: A plugin set plus settings, switched as one.

settings.description: Settings in force while the profile is, over init.yaml's.
